product_intent: A small desktop-sized storage box with a hinged lid that remains closed until manually opened by a user's thumb pressure

clauses.text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid
The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb
The box should be safe to use

requirements.statement: The storage box must have a hinged lid that remains closed until manually opened by thumb pressure

verification.observable: Lid remains closed until thumb pressure is applied to release it
verification.condition: User applies thumb pressure to lid

requirements.statement: The storage box must be safe to use

verification.observable: No sharp edges, hazardous materials, or dangerous configurations

requirements.statement: The storage box must be easy to assemble

verification.observable: Assembly can be completed without special tools or extensive expertise
verification.condition: Assembly process performed by typical user

requirements.statement: The storage box must be practical to manufacture

verification.observable: Design allows for efficient manufacturing process

requirements.statement: The storage box must be desktop-sized
The storage box must operate manually only

verification.observable: Operation requires only manual user input
verification.condition: Product tested with manual operation only

requirements.statement: The storage box must be designed for additive manufacturing

verification.observable: Design features compatible with additive manufacturing process
verification.condition: Design review for additive manufacturing compatibility

operating_scenarios.name: Normal Operation
operating_scenarios.description: User places items in storage box and closes lid manually

operating_scenarios.description: Product is evaluated for safety compliance

operating_scenarios.description: Product design is evaluated for manufacturability
